## Authenticity Verification System

Alpha Tech Nutrition protects consumers against counterfeit gym supplements through an end-to-end QR & serial verification portal:
1. Every tub manufactured has an authenticity panel on the back label.
2. The user scans the QR code or manually inputs the 16-character alphanumeric code at https://alphatech-nutrition.in/verify.
3. The system confirms:
   - Genuine Status (PASS / FAIL)
   - Product Name and Batch Number (e.g. Batch BT00121, Exp. SEP-2026)
   - FSSAI License Match: 21524018000384
   - First-time verification timestamp to prevent reuse of packaging.
